scenes: Hackers stole a record six point three billion dollar from Binance in history's biggest crypto heist.
North Korean attackers drained user wallets within minutes using automated transfer scripts, leveraging a compromised employee laptop.
Co-CEO Richard Teng immediately tapped the billion dollar S A F U emergency fund, futures reserves, and corporate treasury.
By Saturday morning, Dubai-based Binance used company money to buy back ninety percent of the assets from the market.
Users bore zero financial impact as withdrawal services prepared to reopen on Sunday as scheduled.
Leaving hackers with a historic heist that the world's largest exchange absorbed almost overnight through transparent reporting.
